img_description: The diagram illustrates a power distribution system for IT equipment, beginning with a primary and secondary supply feeding into a supply transfer switchgear and continuing through dual uninterruptible power supplies (UPS), before reaching a primary PDU. The system further divides into local PDUs and connects to IT equipment, represented by different symbols indicating energy consumption categories (E_IT) and total energy consumption (E_00). Non-IT loads branch off before the primary PDU, emphasizing separate power paths for non-IT and IT equipment.
